question: Should FaceTime be accepted as an official target only after the full dispatcher and dashboard onboarding described in https://github.com/openclaw/clawsweeper/issues/875, or is this configuration-only profile intentionally a first phase?
rationale: The branch declares the linked onboarding request closed, while that request includes cross-repository dispatcher and operational acceptance criteria that this one-file change does not itself demonstrate.

options.title: Require full onboarding proof
options.body: Keep the linked issue open until the target profile, target-repository dispatcher, and one observed receiver review are verified.

options.title: Approve a staged rollout
options.body: Accept this profile as phase one, remove the closing claim, and retain the linked issue for dispatcher and operational coverage.

recommendation.title: Require full onboarding proof
recommendation.body: Keep the linked issue open until the target profile, target-repository dispatcher, and one observed receiver review are verified.

likelyOwner.reason: The linked issue author supplied the explicit onboarding scope and acceptance criteria that need confirmation.
